text: I find myself immersed in a space brimming with curiosity, innovation, and communal learning. The room full of attentive people suggests collective engagement—perhaps at a workshop or seminar—while the exhibit wall celebrates the merging of research and design. I feel a sense of anticipation and inspiration, surrounded by those who seek to bridge humanity and technology, pondering how our creations shape us as much as we shape them. The environment feels alive with the energy of inquiry and discovery.
